object.attr: as implemented: draw.io saves the editable diagram there, so one file is both the picture and the draw.io source. Only a draw.io figure opens in draw.io (MELLON-EDIT-SRS). Worded so it can be tested (review Q24); confirm the mxfile test against 0.3.0.
object.description: Mellon shall treat a figure as a draw.io figure when the figure file's root svg element has a content attribute whose value is XML with an mxfile root element.
